build_lexicon_graph: build a graph that transduces letters to word pieces using a lexicon of allowed word pieces
build_token_graph: build a graph with individual token transition models for consuming consecutive word pieces
compose_and_project_decompositions: compose an input graph with a lexicon graph and project output to get word piece decompositions
compute_alignment_graph: compute the alignment graph by composing token graph with decompositions and projecting input
compute_sequence_loss: compute sequence level loss by intersecting emissions with alignment graph and subtracting forward scores
